entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen pap mande li anyen ankò." t="I won't ask him for anything anymore." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen pap mande li anyen ankò." t="Nu-i mai cer nimic." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen te kwè se te yonn renmen lòt." t="I thought you liked each other." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Mwen te kwè se te yonn renmen lòt." t="Credeam că vă placeți." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Se sa menm. Mwen pa vle kraze sa a." t="Exactly. I don't want to fuck it up." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Se sa menm. Mwen pa vle kraze sa a." t="Exact. N-o să-o belesc." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Si mesye di non, li pral santi li wont, si mesye di wi se mwen kap santi m dròl." t="If he says no, he'll feel ashamed, and if he says yes, then I'll feel awkward." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Si mesye di non, li pral santi li wont, si mesye di wi se mwen kap santi m dròl." t="Dacă zice nu, o să-i fie rușine, iar dacă zice da, mi-e penibil." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Wa p ekzajere. An jeneral, Jean-ki-ri... Renmen tout moun." t="You're exaggerating. In general, Jean-ki-ri... likes everyone." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Wa p ekzajere. An jeneral, Jean-ki-ri... Renmen tout moun." t="Exagerezi. În general, Jean-ki-ri... place tuturor." b="" a=""/>

entries.en: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Se konsa sa ye? E ben ou pral pale ak mesye." t="Is that so? Then you go talk to him." b="" a=""/>
entries.ro: <kiroshi l="creo" o="Se konsa sa ye? E ben ou pral pale ak mesye." t="Așa e? Atunci du-te și vorbește cu el." b="" a=""/>
